description: This file defines mock classes for the IMediaKeys interface used in testing the Rialto media key management. It includes mock methods for various media key operations and a factory mock for creating media key instances.

classes.name: MediaKeysMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IMediaKeys interface for testing media key operations.

classes.name: MediaKeysFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks selecting a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key exists in a session.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Mocks creating a new key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mocks updating a session with response data.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the DRM store hash.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the key store hash.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error code.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Mocks creating a new IMediaKeys instance for a given key system.
